name: Snowdrop no Okuri Kata
original_name: スノードロップの贈り方
source:
On a freezing winter day, the young man met her.  
As if a frozen clock began to tick,  
waking from a silent slumber,  
their feet started to move forward.  
Guided by their hearts toward the end just ahead,
a conclusion as gentle as early spring.

"How to Gift a Snowdrop" is an omnibus-style visual novel.  
It consists of three chapters with no choices, and the story unfolds from the perspectives of each protagonist.

[Translated from [url=https://curare-game.com/snowdrop/]the official website[/url]]
translation:
在一个寒冷的冬日，年轻人遇见了她。
仿佛冻结的时钟开始滴答作响，
从无声的沉睡中醒来，
他们的脚开始向前迈进。
被他们的心指引着走向前方的终点，
一个如初春般温柔的结论。

《如何赠送雪花莲》是一部综合风格的视觉小说。
它由三章组成，没有选择，故事从每个主角的角度展开。

[翻译自[url=https://curare-game.com/snowdrop/]官网[/url]]
